verdict.rationale: The docs show `$skill-installer` installing individual curated skills by name from the openai/skills collection (e.g. `$skill-installer linear`, `$skill-installer gh-address-comments`, defaulting to `skills/.curated`), so developers can pick single skills rather than the whole set. Plugins are also installed one at a time from a marketplace via `/plugins`. Missing for 10: any evidence of selecting a subset of skills inside a bundled plugin, documentation of how picking and managing installed skills works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
